Hi Sara — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a single action list:

- What we understood from the call: CardioCore is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing triage workflows (PHI scope). You indicated HIPAA and EU data residency considerations may apply.
- Immediate requests from your security/procurement teams: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a bridge letter if report predates go-live, and access to our trust portal for evidence review.
- You mentioned a vendor security questionnaire (procurement) — happy to take that first pass.

Next steps / asks for CardioCore (can you confirm timelines?):
1) Send over your vendor questionnaire (or point us to a shared doc) — procurement@cardiocore.com copied.
2) If you need it now, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and a draft bridge letter by EOD tomorrow. Full Type II report delivery will follow the NDA / redaction process.
3) We’ll provision a read-only trust portal access for your security reviewers — please confirm the list of reviewer emails and whether SSO is required.

I’ve looped in Jordan (security) and Ben (account lead) to help with the bridge letter and portal provisioning.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
